newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian PM resting comfortably, acting PM says.
newsitem.headline: Australian PM resting comfortably, acting PM says.

text.p: Australia's pneumonia-stricken Prime Minister John Howard was resting comfortably in a Sydney hospital, acting leader Tim Fischer said on Tuesday.
Asked about Howard's condition, Fischer told reporters: "Comfortable."
Howard was admitted on Friday with pneumonia and is expected to remain in hospital for most of this week.
Fischer was speaking after a cabinet meeting in Perth, the second in a week Howard has missed because of his illness.
Treasurer Peter Costello takes over as acting prime minister on Tuesday night, when Fischer leaves the country for an official visit to Japan.
